Vision Government Solutions

|

WOODSTOCK,CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the WOODSTOCK, CT Online Assessment
Database. This database allows access to
the data compiled for the 2025 Valuation Update. The proposed values shown were derived for
tax purposes by the Assessor’s office in accordance with Connecticut General
Statutes.

The previous revaluation was completed in 2021. CT state laws require towns to revalue every five years. The CT Office of Policy and Management has re-arranged the state-wide revaluation schedule and moved Woodstock to 2025.

2025 Revaluation

The Town of Woodstock has selected Vision Government
Solutions to assist with the town-wide 2025 revaluation project. Vision’s
Appraisal division will be working closely with the Assessing Department to
make the process successful for the Town. We wish to thank the residents of Woodstock for their cooperation throughout the valuation update project.

Informal hearings have been completed and revised assessment notices have been mailed.

Please note that the PA490 values have been reverted to the 2020 OPM values January 20, 2026.

Body copy from Revised Notice of Assessment Change:

D ear Woodstock
Property Owner:

In accordance with
Connecticut General Statutes, the Town of Woodstock has completed a Revaluation
of all real property for the October 1, 2025 Grand List. Pursuant to section
12-55 of the Connecticut General Statutes, shown below is the revised
assessment of your property as established by the Assessor and Vision
Government Solutions.

This second notice informs
you that, as part of the hearing and review process, your assessment has been
reviewed. Your assessment has either been reduced, increased, or has had no
change made. Most property owners receiving this notice have attended a hearing
or requested a review of their property in writing. Some property owners who
did not attend a hearing or request a review in writing have been sent this
notice to inform them that, upon review, and information provided, their
assessment has been revised.

Your assessment represents
70% of October 1, 2025 market value unless it is classified in whole or in part
under P.A.490 as farm, forest or open space land. Other exemptions to assessments (for example:
Veteran’s exemptions) are not shown as part of this notice but will be applied
to the final assessments.

Do not apply the current tax (mill) rate
to your new assessment, as doing so will result in an inaccurate calculation.

The
new mill rate will be determined by the Town in the spring of 2026.

You may review your new
assessment on the Vision Government Solutions web site: www.vgsi.com . This site will allow
inquiry access to the Assessor’s database, including value summary, property
data, and general revaluation information.

If you wish to appeal your
assessment after receiving your result letter from the informal hearing
you must file a written application with the Board of Assessment Appeals on or
before February 20, 2026. The
applications will be available in the Assessor’s Office and the Town BAA webpage.
